html:
Eritrea is a country on the Red Sea coast of the Horn of Africa, with Asmara as its capital. Its borders were drawn by Italy, which made it a colony in 1890.

The highlands had been the heart of Aksum and later the northern frontier of the Ethiopian Empire, while the Ottomans and then Egypt held the port of Massawa. Italy took the coast in the 1880s. Eritrea was its oldest colony, and Italian armies marched from it into Ethiopia twice: they lost at Adwa in 1896 and won in 1936.

  • 1941: Britain took it in World War II and ran it for ten years.
  • 1952: the United Nations joined it to Ethiopia in a federation; in 1962 Haile Selassie annexed it outright.
  • 1961 to 1991: the war of independence, one of the longest in Africa.
  • 1993: independence after a referendum, under Isaias Afwerki, who still rules without elections.
  • 1998 to 2000: a border war with Ethiopia; peace came only in 2018.
sum: Eritrea is a country on the Red Sea coast of the Horn of Africa, with Asmara as its capital. Its borders were drawn by Italy, which made it a colony in 1890.
